pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-selection-slots
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C for three adjacent PAL slot-lookup routines. func_004A9948 scans three slots for the active index (88 bytes); func_004A99A0 performs the same scan for a supplied index (64 bytes). Each returns the first empty slot or 3 if none is empty. func_004A99E0 returns the address of the first nonzero field at record offsets 0x24 / 0x28, falling back to the three-slot array (80 bytes). Its partial record type preserves the 0xB8 stride.

pullRequests.title: Match two PAL timed object-parameter accessors
pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-object-parameters
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C for the PAL object-parameter setter func_00489498 (120 bytes) and getter func_00489510 (64 bytes), sharing a partial state layout. The setter uses the supplied value/duration and sets the dirty flag only when flag 0x20 is enabled and the duration is positive; otherwise it resets the value to 1.0 and the duration to zero. The getter returns 1.0 when the state is absent or the flag is disabled. Both retain the original null-state behavior.

pullRequests.title: Match PAL wrapped and clamped index stepping
pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-navigation-state
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C for PAL func_00496118 (84 bytes), which advances an index. Wrap mode returns (current + step + count) % count; otherwise negative steps clamp at zero and nonnegative steps clamp at count - 1. It preserves the original signed arithmetic and does not introduce additional checks or normalization.

pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-event-callbacks
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C for the adjacent PAL event-state callbacks func_0048A7E8 (76 bytes) and func_0048A838 (84 bytes), with a shared partial structure. Both reset state on a zero event and transition to state 4 from their respective states 1 and 9, conditionally setting the notification at 0x002069FC. The second callback preserves its negative-events-only store, and both retain the original signed 32-bit pointer conversion from the 64-bit callback argument.

pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-capped-parameter
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C for PAL func_0048AE20 (84 bytes). It resolves the supplied handle through func_0048B428, writes the value capped only above at 1.0 to entry offset 0x20, and returns whether the lookup succeeded. It retains the unused first argument and introduces no lower clamp.
The file-wide -ffast-math flag makes the ordinary C conditional compile to retail's min.s; the existing compiler/assembler pipeline is unchanged.

Adds matching C for seventeen PAL fixed-size hash-table lookup variants: fourteen eight-slot routines (112 bytes each) and three three-slot routines (128 bytes each), totaling 1,952 bytes.
